title: Immersive Escape Rooms

services.name: Botanica Greenhouse
services.desc: Luck is on your side - you and your team won tickets to the prestigious Interstellar Botanical Expedition. Your journey takes you to the renowned Botanica Greenhouse, home to the galaxy’s most diverse collection of advanced alien plant life and hybrid botanical technology. Prepare for a wondrous tour led by Doctor Brenda Glores, the expert in botanical energy and sustainable ecosystems. This breathtaking greenhouse has many exhibits to explore and is known for being a highly hands-on experience. Your timing couldn’t be better. A revolutionary new discovery known as Echo-a mysterious plant that can speak-has just been unveiled. This once-in-a-lifetime encounter may change everything we know

services.name: Our Escape Rooms
services.desc: Welcome to Daydream Adventures - Toronto’s escape room for kids and teens where art, storytelling, and puzzles spark imagination! Our family-friendly escape rooms are the perfect adventure for all ages to discover hands-on fun. Kids love to explore new worlds and take in the movie-like environment. This immersive experience is a creative test of problem solving and teamwork skills, making it a great activity for teens to boost their confidence. If you are looking for an indoor activity in Toronto or Scarborough, Daydream is an adventure like never before and it is packed with beautiful, photo-worthy moments. blurb: Looking for the best escape room in Toronto? Daydream Adventures is a premium blend of cinematic set design, immersive storytelling, innovative technology and movie-quality production, designed in collaboration with Toronto artists.

quotes.author: Kimberly R.
quotes.text: Clever, well-designed game! We did the Dream portal room with a group of 4 adults and found it challenging but not impossible.

quotes.author: John L
quotes.text: Of the two rooms, we did the Ice Cave one in Toronto. This was Dream Adventures' first location. They have since open a second one in Scarborough. On its own, the escape was creative and the gameplay was above average. But when compared to other escape rooms out there, this experience feels dated and lacking in polish. The place also seems understaffed. We requested hints on multiple occasions mid game and received zero

quotes.author: Chana
quotes.text: One of the best interactive escape rooms ever it was actually crazyI’ve been to many escape rooms but in this one everything is well made, everything was interactive and it felt magical, from the mechanics to the voice acting and the propsWould recommend

quotes.author: Kayla D.
quotes.text: We had an absolute AWESOME time ! We did the Brimley Manor experience with our 8 year , the puzzles were challenging enough but not impossible to solve ! Our Gamemaster was fantastic and made the experience so enjoyable we escaped with 1:25 left on the clock . We will 1000000000% be back , we would love for them to open a location in the West end please !

quotes.author: Jeffrey F.
quotes.text: As the owner of an escape room business, I know what goes in to building a great adventure. Daydream Adventures have hit the mark in the bullseye with the 2 rooms we played. Don't hesitate to book a spot for the Dream Portal and Ice Cave. Impossible to be dissapointed. They have create something very special.

quotes.author: Kaylah
quotes.text: Great experience and wonderful staff. Really beautiful and hand made by local artists and staff. Will definitely come back!

quotes.author: Robyn C.
quotes.text: This was an absolutely phenomenal experience! We did both the Ice Cave and Dream Portal and both were incredible! They both feel like they transport you into a different dimension and draw you deep into the story! Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Paige
quotes.text: I love daydream adventures. This is the best escape room I have ever done. Not only are they so unique, but they also double as an art installation. The set is jaw dropping. It is so beautiful and immersive. I'm from the UK, and we don't have anything like this here. I will be coming back on my next family visit to Toronto. I can't wait to see their new creations. It is a must try experience in Toronto.

quotes.author: Harlan K.
quotes.text: Unique puzzles, interesting story, lots of fun. We received some extra time, but managed to defeat the monster and escape from the ice cave, with several helpful hints.

quotes.author: Steve R.
quotes.text: The experience was nothing less than AMAZING!! The decor, the puzzle , the staff were all amazing ! I would recommend anyone to come try this location out!!!!!

quotes.author: Kirstie D.
quotes.text: Strongly suggest visiting! It was such a great experience and the staff is super friendly. Will visit again if ever we come back to GTA.

quotes.author: Leila J.
quotes.text: We had so much fun at the dream portal! The staff was super helpful and patient when we needed clues. We will definitely be back to try the ice!
